notes.title: New Update
notes.content:
[b]-We have enhanced tutorial part of the game. You won't be confused anymore.
-Subtitles and hints are now more remarkable.
-Fixed an issue where cryptex was scaling when crouched
-Sensitivity and Volume options can be properly saved.
-Additional SFX was added for certain objects. 
-Fixed typo errors in journal.
-Minor bugs were fixed.
-One more achievement was added.[/b]


On the other hand, we are about to kick our main game's project on Kickstarter. We kindly ask your help to achieve our goal. Definitely, that campaign is going to help us a lot. 

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/corvus13/13-origin]13:ORIGIN KICKSTARTER CAMPAIGN[/url]


Cheer!
